notes.subject: רק בזדון
notes.rationale: רק here reads 'only' (contention comes only from pride) or as noun 'leanness/empty strife'; ASV/JPS take 'only', YLT reads a vain man

notes.subject: חכמה
notes.rationale: Kik 'ũgeni' carries counsel/wisdom sense; Hebrew חכמה is broader skill-and-wisdom

notes.subject: נועצים
notes.rationale: hiphil participle of יעץ — 'those who take counsel together', reciprocal form echoed in the antithesis

translation: Rĩra-ĩmwe nĩ kũingĩha kwa ngoro ndwaro kũhũthagĩra kĩrĩa kĩrarĩirwo, no andũ a kĩrĩkanĩro ⟨את⟩ arĩa maahĩtaga ũgeni mambi magĩe nao.

tokens.marks: andũ a kĩrĩkanĩro arĩa maahĩtaga ũgeni
